_meta.note: NCHS age-adjusted death rate from HIV disease: Health, United States Table SlctMort for 1987–2019 and CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death final data for 2020–2024 (read through a real browser and checked in; its 2018–2019 values equal the Health US table).
